admission.justification: Treating a measured current limitation as a permanent capability, or concealing it, misleads later launch work.

applicability: The admitted Codex, ACP/Hermes and Pi exception on host0.11.1.
conditions: The lack of a supported per-launch mechanism is source-proved and architect-ruled.

exclusions: No permanent claim about later host/provider versions.
